items.name: Namibia Nationals 2026
items.information:
First official WCA competition in Namibia.

The fastest competitor from Namibia in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Namibia.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Namibia nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Namibia nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.
